source.name: RULER (paper, NVIDIA)
source.description: Per-category RULER results from the paper appendix (arXiv:2404.06654v3, Tables 13-16).
source.attribution: Hsieh et al., RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models? arXiv:2404.06654 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.06654).
notes: Score = the table's Avg. column (mean of 4K-128K). Per-length scores, claimed/effective length and weighted averages (with the paper's rank) in extra.
Both aligned and base models are included (extra.model_type). Llama2-7B (chat/base) rows were left out: the paper gives only a 4K score and no average.
These are the paper's 2024 models; the README's newer models have only 13-task totals (already in the DB as RULER).

benchmarks.name: RULER - Retrieval (NIAH)
benchmarks.description: RULER Retrieval (NIAH) (average of 8 NIAH tasks): accuracy (%) averaged over 4K-128K context lengths, from the RULER paper appendix (Table 13).

benchmarks.name: RULER - Multi-hop Tracing (VT)
benchmarks.description: RULER Multi-hop Tracing (VT) (variable tracking): accuracy (%) averaged over 4K-128K context lengths, from the RULER paper appendix (Table 14).

benchmarks.name: RULER - Aggregation (CWE/FWE)
benchmarks.description: RULER Aggregation (CWE/FWE) (average of CWE and FWE): accuracy (%) averaged over 4K-128K context lengths, from the RULER paper appendix (Table 15).

benchmarks.name: RULER - Question Answering
benchmarks.description: RULER Question Answering (average of 2 QA tasks): accuracy (%) averaged over 4K-128K context lengths, from the RULER paper appendix (Table 16).
